api.base_url: https://api.intacct.com/ia/api/v1 (from Nango providers.yaml: base https://api.intacct.com/ia/api, authorize/token under /ia/api/v1/oauth2/); legacy XML gateway also exists

scopes_needed_read: UNVERIFIED (permissions come from the Web Services user's role, not scopes)
auth.refresh: Authorization code grant returns refresh token (Nango config lists refresh_token grant); client credentials needs no refresh

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Sage Intacct developer program (client ID and secret are issued when you register an application; web services developer license with sender ID needed for legacy XML)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Registration of the application with Sage required to receive client ID/secret; marketplace listing not required for private integration (UNVERIFIED)
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Create a Web Services user (Company > Admin > Web Services Users > Add) with a role of needed permissions; then Company > Setup > Company > Edit > Security > Authorized Client Applications > Add, enter our Client ID and the Web Services user ID. For legacy XML also authorize our Web Services sender ID. Customer's subscription must include Web Services.

sandbox.how_to_get: Developer/partner sandbox company provided with developer program; public self-serve UNVERIFIED

incremental_sync: REST list endpoints with filter on whenModified > cursor (exact filter param name UNVERIFIED); legacy XML readByQuery on WHENMODIFIED also works
blockers: Must register as Sage developer to obtain client ID/secret (gatekeeping, cost UNVERIFIED)
Customer needs web services entitlement and admin to authorize client app
OpenAPI spec and rate limits not retrievable (403)
sources: https://developer.sage.com/intacct/docs/developer-portal/authorization-security/oauth2/ (search snippet) - "Client applications can use the authorization code or the client credentials grant type"
same page - "the client application must be associated with a Web Services user and explicitly authorized in a company's configuration"
https://developer.intacct.com/web-services/ (search snippet) - "You must have an active Sage Intacct Web Services developer license, which includes a Web Services sender ID and password"
